channel.title: Search Engine Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Search Engine Journal (searchenginejournal.com)

item.title: The Alpha Is Not LLM Monitoring
item.description: Exclusive data about the AI Search funding landscape reveals the true upside of the market – and potential down rounds.

item.title: Paid Ad Scheduling Across Time Zones That Actually Works
item.description: Improve PPC performance across time zones with smarter ad scheduling, data-driven timing, and automation that reaches audiences when they’re most ready to act.

item.title: The Impact AI Is Having On The Marketing Ecosystem
item.description: While the marketing game is changing, AI hasn't been the catalyst. The shift has been happening for years, we've just been slow to pick up on it.

item.title: SEO Pulse: ChatGPT Gets Shopping & What Drives AI Citations
item.description: This week’s SEO Pulse examines new data what drives AI citations, plus ChatGPT launches shopping research. Your quick catch-up on what practitioners need to know.

item.title: Google's Mueller Says Sites In A ‘Bad State’ May Need To Start Over
item.description: Google's John Mueller says sites with low-quality AI content should rethink their purpose rather than manually rewrite pages. Starting fresh may be faster than recovering.

item.title: Pragmatic Approach To AI Search Visibility
item.description: Citations and placement in AI answers are turning into the visibility signals that decide who enters the final click.

item.title: AI Poisoning: Black Hat SEO Is Back
item.description: New research finds Black Hats can poison LLMs with just 250 malicious documents. Learn how poisoning threatens your brand and what to do about it.

item.title: Should Your PPC Strategy Focus On The Lead Pipeline Or Revenue?
item.description: Discover how marketing leaders decide whether PPC should drive pipeline or revenue, and how that choice shapes platforms, budgets, and performance outcomes.

item.title: Google Reports Search Console Page Indexing Report Delays
item.description: Google announces delays in Search Console's Page indexing report. The company confirms crawling, indexing, and ranking remain unaffected by the reporting issue.

item.title: Google Connects AI Overviews To AI Mode On Mobile
item.description: Google is testing a mobile search flow that lets you move from AI Overviews into AI Mode without leaving the results page.
